log.text: Stealth Rock up on P2's side
Light Screen up on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Lead Bastiodon+Empoleon: slow core thrives under Trick Room, Empoleon Surf hits Camerupt 4x on entry, Bastiodon Sturdy/WideGuard wall. Bench Gengar (fast/fragile, mismatched vs TR). Back Grimmsnarl (screens/Prankster) and Arcanine (Intimidate, ExtremeSpeed priority finisher) cover Mawile-Mega and cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, need 1 win. Opp TR team: Farigiraf leads TR (ArmorTail) then faints; Mawile-Mega (Brave HugePower) KnockOff SE vs Ghost, Protect blocks BodyPress, SuckerPunch finisher; Camerupt (Quiet SolidRock) EarthPower 4x Bastiodon/2x others, weak to Surf 4x; Heliolisk ChoiceScarf DrySkin unused; Chandelure/Liepard not brought G2. Our Gengar-Mega mismatched vs TR (fast/fragile). BodyPress insufficient to KO Mawile. Plan: lead slow core Bastiodon/Empoleon, Surf Camerupt on entry, bench Gengar. G3 brought Bastiodon,Empoleon,Grimmsnarl,Arcanine; bench Gengar,Lucario.

decisions.rationale: Lead Farigiraf+Camerupt to establish Trick Room while immediately threatening Mega Camerupt spread pressure. Mega Mawile is the primary Gengar punish and physical win condition; Chandelure supplies a secondary Trick Room/Imprison option and benefits from the slow-mode structure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Game 2 selection was Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Bastiodon, and Intimidate Arcanine; Grimmsnarl and Lucario were not brought. Known sets: Mega Gengar Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect; Empoleon Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect; Bastiodon Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press; Arcanine Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Will-O-Wisp/Protect. Against this Gengar/Steel core, prioritize Trick Room, preserve Mega Mawile as Gengar pressure, and use Camerupt Earth Power when Bastiodon can Wide Guard.

decisions.rationale: ArmorTail only blocks priority moves targeting foes, so our self/ally Protect is safe but unneeded. Empoleon Surf hits Camerupt 4x (SolidRock cuts it to 61-145%, not a sure KO) and chips Farigiraf. Bastiodon sets Stealth Rock: vs a likely Protect+TR opponent it's the only move that yields value if Camerupt shields, and it punishes their switches under Trick Room. Robust against both Protect and attack lines; a living Camerupt is the real danger we'll handle next turn.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, need 1 win (game 3). Opp TR team: Farigiraf (ArmorTail — blocks ONLY priority moves that TARGET foes; our self/ally-targeting Protect/Wide Guard are SAFE), Camerupt (Cameruptite, Quiet SolidRock; 4x weak to Surf but SolidRock cuts it so Surf alone not a sure KO; Earth Power 4x Bastiodon/2x others), plus 2 of Mawile/Liepard/Heliolisk/Chandelure. Plan: lead Bastiodon+Empoleon, Surf Camerupt, set Stealth Rock, bench Gengar/Lucario. Body Press (Def 190) adds ~20-58% to help KO Camerupt if it attacks instead of Protecting. If Camerupt Protects+TR sets, keep rocks and pivot next turn. Main danger = living Camerupt under TR; avoid overcommitting both mons to a shielded target.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt)
decisions.rationale: Set Trick Room while Mega Camerupt protects from Empoleon’s likely Surf. This preserves Camerupt at full HP for a high-power Trick Room attack next turn; single-target Earth Power also bypasses Bastiodon’s Wide Guard.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Game 2 selection was Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Bastiodon, and Intimidate Arcanine; Grimmsnarl and Lucario were not brought. Known sets: Mega Gengar Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect; Empoleon Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect; Bastiodon Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press; Arcanine Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Will-O-Wisp/Protect. Against Gengar/Steel, prioritize Trick Room, preserve Mega Mawile if Camerupt has not committed its Mega, and use Camerupt Earth Power when Bastiodon can Wide Guard.

decisions.rationale: Camerupt Earth Power is a guaranteed KO on Bastiodon from 71% HP, but Bastiodon Protect (+4) always outpaces Earth Power (+0) under TR, so Protect hard-counters it. Empoleon Surf (4x, 51-112%) is our only real damage on Camerupt (Flash Cannon 0.5x); it also chips Farigiraf. Body Press would expose Bastiodon to the 4x KO, so rejected. Safe, high-value play.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, game 3 decider. Opp TR team: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks only foe-targeting priority; our self/ally Protect/Wide Guard safe), Camerupt-Mega (SolidRock; 4x weak Surf but SolidRock+spread 0.75x => Surf ~51-112% not guaranteed KO; Earth Power 4x KO on Bastiodon from 71%). 2 of Mawile/Liepard/Heliolisk/Chandelure unrevealed. Key: Bastiodon Protect (+4) always outpaces Camerupt Earth Power (+0) under TR, so Protect hard-counters the 4x KO. Plan: Protect Bastiodon + Surf Camerupt each turn it doesn't Protect; if Camerupt shields (reduced success after 1 use), stall and retry. Bench Grimmsnarl (screens), Arcanine (Intimidate).

decisions.rationale: Empoleon fainted; switch in Grimmsnarl. Its Prankster Light Screen (priority, not blocked by Armor Tail) cuts Camerupt's Earth Power 50%, letting Bastiodon survive the 4x hit without Protect. Grimmsnarl resists Psychic and is neutral to Fire/Ground, unlike Arcanine (weak to Ground, fast/bad in TR, Intimidate useless vs special foes). Bastiodon stays (Pass).
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, game 3 decider vs TR team. Opp: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks only foe-targeting priority; our self/ally Protect/Wide Guard/screens safe), Camerupt-Mega (SolidRock; 4x weak Surf but SolidRock+spread 0.75x => not guaranteed KO; Earth Power 4x KO Bastiodon from 71%). 2 of Mawile/Liepard/Heliolisk/Chandelure unrevealed. Plan: Bastiodon Protect(+4) outpaces Camerupt Earth Power(+0) under TR, hard-counters 4x KO. Grimmsnarl Prankster Light Screen cuts special 50%, lets Bastiodon survive Earth Power w/o Protect. Bench Grimmsnarl(screens,Light Clay), Arcanine(Intimidate low value vs special foes; weak Ground).

decisions.rationale: Earth Power followed by Psychic Noise guarantees the Empoleon KO across the shown damage ranges before it can use Surf under Trick Room. This preserves Camerupt while leaving Bastiodon as the only active foe; its Wide Guard cannot stop either selected attack.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 opponent brought Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Bastiodon, and Intimidate Arcanine; Grimmsnarl and Lucario were not brought that game. Known sets: Mega Gengar Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect; Empoleon Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect; Bastiodon Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press; Arcanine Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Will-O-Wisp/Protect. Against Gengar/Steel, prioritize Trick Room, preserve Mega Mawile if Camerupt has not committed its Mega, and use Camerupt Earth Power when Bastiodon can Wide Guard.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
Light Screen (your side, including ally Bastiodon)
decisions.rationale: Earth Power 4x KOs Bastiodon from 71%, but Bastiodon Protect (+4) blocks it; if Protect fails (50%), Grimmsnarl Prankster Light Screen halves Earth Power so Bastiodon survives (only top ~15% of roll KOs). Light Screen also cushions Eruption spread on Grimmsnarl (31-55%). Keeps our slow TR wall alive and sets a screen. Best EV play.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, game 3 decider vs TR team. Opp: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks only foe-targeting priority; our self/ally Protect/Wide Guard/screens safe), Camerupt-Mega (SolidRock; 4x Earth Power KOs Bastiodon from 71% w/o screen, but Light Screen halves to ~44-75% survivable; Eruption spread 31-55% on Grimmsnarl w/ Light Screen). 2 of Mawile/Liepard/Heliolisk/Chandelure unrevealed. Plan: Bastiodon Protect + Grimmsnarl Prankster Light Screen each turn to halve special; Bastiodon (SpD 209, slow 50) ideal TR wall. Avoid bringing Arcanine in TR (fast 147 acts last, weak Ground).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Imprison denies the opposing Protect and Trick Room options, creating lasting endgame pressure, while Earth Power is a guaranteed KO on Bastiodon even through a possible Light Screen and is unaffected by Wide Guard.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 opponent has revealed Bastiodon, Empoleon, and Grimmsnarl; final bring remains unknown. Game 2 final bring set included Mega Gengar and Intimidate Arcanine, so respect either where applicable. Farigiraf Imprison can deny opposing Protect and Trick Room; prioritize it when it does not sacrifice essential immediate board control. Against Bastiodon, use single-target Camerupt Earth Power rather than spread Fire attacks because Wide Guard is available. Preserve Mega Mawile when feasible for the Gengar/Steel endgame.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Arcanine)
decisions.rationale: Earth Power can OHKO Arcanine through Light Screen (60-104%), but I can't block it: Imprison blocks my Protect, ArmorTail blocks Extreme Speed/Taunt. Best upside is Flare Blitz Farigiraf (44-81%, KO chance) to remove ArmorTail+Imprison and enable my post-TR sweep. Grimmsnarl holds Light Screen vs special threats.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, game3 decider vs TR team. Opp TR core: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks only foe-targeting priority; self/ally screens safe - Light Screen worked T3), Camerupt-Mega (SolidRock; Earth Power 2x on Arcanine, can OHKO through Light Screen 60-104%). Imprison (Farigiraf) blocks my Protect while active. 2 of Mawile/Liepard/Heliolisk/Chandelure unrevealed benched. Plan: KO Farigiraf to lift ArmorTail+Imprison, then Arcanine Extreme Speed sweep once TR ends (~T6). Keep Light Screen vs special.

decisions.rationale: Earth Power plus Psychic Noise gives the best chance to remove Arcanine through Light Screen while Imprison prevents either foe from Protecting. Farigiraf should survive a noncritical Flare Blitz from its current health, preserving the lock and board control.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 reveals Empoleon (Leftovers, Calm: Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect), Bastiodon (Sitrus, Calm: Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press), Grimmsnarl (Light Clay, Impish: Light Screen/Reflect/Taunt/Protect), and Intimidate Arcanine (Expert Belt, Adamant: Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Will-O-Wisp/Protect). Opponent’s final Game 3 bring remains unknown; Game 2 included Mega Gengar. Farigiraf Imprison denies opposing Protect and Trick Room while it remains active; Armor Tail blocks priority targeting its side. Against Bastiodon, prioritize single-target Earth Power over spread Fire due to Wide Guard. Preserve Mega Mawile where feasible for a potential Gengar/Steel endgame.

decisions.rationale: Only Grimmsnarl remains and it has zero attacking moves, so the game is unwinnable; Protect is also blocked by Farigiraf's Imprison. I pass rather than forfeit and use Reflect for full defensive coverage (Light Screen already up, Protect illegal). Camerupt cannot OHKO even with Eruption under Light Screen.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR team core: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks only foe-targeting priority; self/ally screens safe; knows Trick Room, Imprison, Psychic Noise, Protect; Mental Herb; Sassy) + Camerupt-Mega (SolidRock; Earth Power 2x on Fire/Arcanine; Quiet). Imprison (Farigiraf) blocks my Protect while active. Benched 2 of Mawile/Liepard/Heliolisk/Chandelure (unrevealed). Keep Light Screen vs special; Taunt Farigiraf to deny status; KO Farigiraf to lift ArmorTail+Imprison before sweeping.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Earth Power is the strongest reliable single-target damage through Light Screen and acts first under the final Trick Room turn. Reusing Trick Room is the only route to preserve Camerupt’s speed control if Grimmsnarl does not Taunt; it has no meaningful downside here.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 opponent brought Empoleon, Bastiodon, Grimmsnarl, and Intimidate Arcanine; Gengar and Lucario were not brought. Empoleon: Leftovers, Calm, Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect. Bastiodon: Sitrus Berry, Calm, Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press. Grimmsnarl: Light Clay, Impish, Light Screen/Reflect/Taunt/Protect, Prankster. Arcanine: Expert Belt, Adamant, Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Will-O-Wisp/Protect, Intimidate. Farigiraf’s Imprison denies opposing Protect and Trick Room while active; Armor Tail blocks priority targeting its side. Preserve Mega Mawile where feasible for a potential Gengar/Steel endgame.

decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl is my last Pokémon and carries only status moves (no attack), so the game is unwinnable. Pass with fainted Arcanine; use Prankster Taunt on Farigiraf to deny its Protect/Trick Room/Imprison and disrupt their TR core. Forfeit only ends faster with no benefit.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR team core: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks only foe-targeting priority; self/ally screens safe; knows Trick Room, Imprison, Psychic Noise, Protect; Mental Herb; Sassy) + Camerupt-Mega (SolidRock; Earth Power 2x on Fire/Arcanine; Quiet). Imprison (Farigiraf) blocks my Protect while active. Benched 2 of Mawile/Liepard/Heliolisk/Chandelure (unrevealed). Lesson: Grimmsnarl is support-only (no attacking move) — never rely on it to close games; bring a real wincon vs TR. Taunt Farigiraf to deny status; KO Farigiraf to lift ArmorTail+Imprison before sweeping.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Set Trick Room for any follow-up while full-power Eruption has the highest immediate damage into Grimmsnarl through Light Screen; Imprison prevents its Protect and Armor Tail blocks Prankster disruption targeting this side.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 opponent brought Empoleon, Bastiodon, Grimmsnarl, and Intimidate Arcanine; Gengar and Lucario were not brought. Empoleon: Leftovers, Calm, Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect. Bastiodon: Sitrus Berry, Calm, Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press. Grimmsnarl: Light Clay, Impish, Light Screen/Reflect/Taunt/Protect, Prankster. Arcanine: Expert Belt, Adamant, Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Will-O-Wisp/Protect, Intimidate. Farigiraf Imprison denies opposing Protect and Trick Room while active; Armor Tail blocks priority targeting its side. Preserve Mega Mawile where feasible for a potential Gengar/Steel endgame.

reflections.summary: Game 3 lost because the four brought (Bastiodon, Empoleon, Grimmsnarl, Arcanine) were support/defensive with no wincon vs opponent TR core (Farigiraf + Camerupt-Mega). Between-game adjustment to add screens/SR/Intimidate backfired: we omitted Mega Gengar and Lucario, leaving no way to KO Farigiraf or break Imprison/ArmorTail, and Arcanine was OHKO'd by Earth Power. Series lost 1-2 as we failed to field a fighting/ghost attacker to counter TR in games 2-3 despite notebook lessons.
reflections.adjustment: Future series: always include Lucario (Fighting STAB super effective vs Farigiraf) or Mega Gengar in active four with Grimmsnarl screens; keep Arcanine for Intimidate, Bastiodon for Wide Guard vs Eruption. Do not bring only passive walls/support. Evolve Mega Gengar if ghost damage needed. Focus on KOing Farigiraf to lift ArmorTail+Imprison rather than Taunt (blocked by ArmorTail). Left-behind Garchomp/Slowbro not clearly better; Lucario must be registered and brought.
reflections.notebook: Opp TR core: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks foe-target priority only; Mental Herb; Sassy; Trick Room, Imprison, Psychic Noise, Protect) + Camerupt-Mega (Quiet, SolidRock; Earth Power 2x on Fire/Arcanine; Eruption). Imprison blocks our Protect while Farigiraf active. Psychic Noise is Psychic, useless vs Dark (Grimmsnarl immune). Benched 2 of Mawile (Intimidate/Mawilite), Chandelure (FlashFire/Chandelurite), Liepard (Prankster/FocusSash), Heliolisk (ChoiceScarf/DrySkin). Need wincon hitting Farigiraf super effectively (Lucario Fighting or Mega Gengar Ghost) with screens; never rely on Grimmsnarl offense. KO Farigiraf to lift Imprison/ArmorTail before sweeping.

reflections.summary: Won Game 3 and the series 2-1 because the Farigiraf + Mega Camerupt lead directly matched the opponent's slow defensive mode: Trick Room went up safely, Camerupt's Protect absorbed Empoleon's Surf, and Earth Power removed Empoleon, Bastiodon, and Arcanine before screens could meaningfully stabilize them. Farigiraf's Imprison then shut off the opponent's Protect-based stalling and its Armor Tail blocked Prankster Taunt, leaving Grimmsnarl unable to disrupt the finish. The between-game adjustment to bring and Mega Evolve Camerupt helped decisively; Mega Mawile and Chandelure were reasonable back-line insurance but were unnecessary. The Game 3 four suited this revealed opponent better than a faster or priority-centered plan. Series prep was largely sound: Farigiraf/Camerupt was an excellent anti-Trick Room, anti-priority, anti-bulky-Steel core, while Mawile covered a possible Gengar/Lucario endgame. The main prep concern is that the registered six leaned heavily into three Mega options while Palafin, Rotom-Fan, or Tauros could have supplied more flexible non-Mega speed, pivoting, or physical pressure, but the opponent's actual defensive Steel core made the registered Camerupt package the correct call.
reflections.adjustment: For a future series, continue prioritizing Farigiraf + Mega Camerupt into Empoleon/Bastiodon/Grimmsnarl structures, with Mawile retained when Gengar or Lucario is plausible. Respect Wide Guard and screens, but do not overplay around them: single-target Ground pressure cleanly punished their likely defensive line. Lead Farigiraf when Prankster Taunt or priority is expected, use Imprison after Trick Room when Protect stalling is their route, and preserve Camerupt's HP for Eruption only once their Water pressure is neutralized. In registration, consider whether Palafin or Rotom-Fan offers a more broadly useful sixth than one of the redundant Mega slots if the opponent is expected to pivot away from slow Steel balance.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's revealed defensive mode is Empoleon + Bastiodon with Stealth Rock, Protect, and Bastiodon Wide Guard, backed by Light Clay Grimmsnarl dual screens and Prankster Taunt. Empoleon is Calm Leftovers with Surf/Flash Cannon; Bastiodon is Calm Sitrus with Body Press; Grimmsnarl is Impish with Light Screen/Reflect/Taunt/Protect. Arcanine is Adamant Expert Belt Intimidate with Flare Blitz, Extreme Speed, Will-O-Wisp, and Protect. Against this mode, Mega Camerupt's single-target Earth Power is highly effective; Farigiraf safely enables it through Trick Room, Armor Tail blocks Prankster Taunt and priority, and Imprison denies Protect stalling. Gengar and Lucario were omitted in Game 3, but retain Mega Mawile as a contingency for their Steel/Ghost-oriented alternative. Prep conclusion: Farigiraf + Mega Camerupt is the preferred anti-balance mode; do not rely solely on spread attacks into possible Wide Guard.
